role_archetype.rationale: The role combines a Lead Data Analyst identity with hands-on SQL and Python capabilities, with cyber incident review domain experience defining the preferred candidate path.

evidence_signals.name: Preferred domain-led path: Lead or Senior Data Analyst background, hands-on SQL and Python, 6+ years of experience, and Cyber Incident Review and/or Data Breach Analysis experience; Power Query is not required for this path.

Acceptable capability-led alternative: strong Data Analyst background, Lead level, 6+ years of experience, hands-on SQL and Python, and working knowledge of Power Query; cyber incident review domain experience is not required for this path.
Location depends on candidate path: domain-led candidates may be located anywhere in India, including remotely; capability-led candidates must be in Hyderabad or Pune.
Lead level may be demonstrated through people leadership or technical leadership.

Cyber Incident Review is situated within Legal Tech / Legal Solutions, not cybersecurity operations; SOC, security operations, security analyst work, SIEM, threat detection, security incident response, or generic cyber/incident terminology alone do not establish the requested domain experience.
Background in Legal Tech, LPO, Legal Solutions, legal-services technology, Data Breach Analysis, or related evidence-backed environments.
Hands-on use of SQL and Python for data querying, data analysis, automation, and reporting.
For the capability-led path, working knowledge of Power Query for data transformation, preparation, and reporting is required; this is a lower proficiency bar than hands-on SQL and Python.
Experience performing review, quality assurance, compliance, audit, or security monitoring activities.
Experience leading teams, mentoring analysts, coaching team members, and coordinating operational workflows.
Ability to review, analyse, and interpret large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential risks, with strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail.
Quality oversight and delivery of review services in accordance with security standards, established protocols, and compliance requirements.
Collaboration with technology, security, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders to address review findings and support remediation.
Preparation of management reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support operational and business decisions.
Maintenance of accurate documentation, procedures, audit trails, and quality records in accordance with organizational and client requirements.
Support for the Review Manager through administrative activities, resource planning, workflow prioritization, and team coordination.
Continuous improvement of operational efficiency, quality, productivity, and compliance outcomes.
Experience working with data privacy requirements.
Experience managing cyber incident reviews, breach investigations, or data privacy review workflows.
An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.
